subject.title: RFC 0016 addendum: portable core and harness profiles

question: Should RFC 0016 now standardize the package-local OpenClaw profile contract, or should the addendum retain only the portable core and defer harness-specific normative requirements until a merged implementation is available?
rationale: The remaining question is not a mechanical documentation correction: it determines when an experimental cross-component contract becomes normative and what implementation evidence is sufficient for that decision.

options.title: Confirm and land the full contract
options.body: Confirm that a merged OpenClaw implementation and the corresponding ClawHub behavior match the final profile, host-policy, integrity, and disclosure semantics before merging this RFC addendum.

options.title: Narrow to portable core
options.body: Merge only the opaque metadata and portability principles, while moving the OpenClaw profile pointer and lifecycle guarantees to a later implementation-backed RFC update.

options.title: Defer the addendum
options.body: Keep the PR open until the runtime and registry implementation path is merged and can be reviewed against the normative wording.

recommendation.title: Confirm and land the full contract
recommendation.body: Confirm that a merged OpenClaw implementation and the corresponding ClawHub behavior match the final profile, host-policy, integrity, and disclosure semantics before merging this RFC addendum.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned reviewer has already evaluated the affected OpenClaw configuration, policy, and disclosure boundaries in detail.
